dct_description_sm: Photographs of killer whales (Orcinus orca) in Milne Inlet and Tremblay Sound (7241′57″N 07757′33″W) and Admiralty Inlet, Nunavut (N7216'07.1, W8618'41.5) were collected during several encounters in 2013 and 2015. During the encounters with 15-20+ animals, numerous photographs were taken, and one adult female was matched to an individual observed in Admiralty Inlet in 2009. This fieldwork was part of an ongoing field study of killer whales in the Eastern Canadian Arctic (ECA) using satellite telemetry, biopsy, and photo identification to learn more about killer whale distribution and migration, diet, social structure, and population size.
dct_title_s: Killer whale (Orcinus orca) photo identification database, 2013-2015 (NGMP ID EC05)
